summary.headline: Persian Eclipse and Nativity Chapters
summary.text: Catalog of folios 267–275 in a Persian astrological book, covering eclipse omens for the Sun and Moon, zodiac signs, decans, faces, houses, lunar occultations, and kings. The third book turns to nativities, incarnation, parents, sex, upbringing, bodily temperament, fortune, rank, action, marriage, children, friends, travel, death, and life-periods; the note attributes its doctrine to Hephaestion of Thebes, book II.
